Demo45 月宫天女 (てんにょ様は、未来から · A Celestial from the Future) — prompts for the layered art (DEMO_DESIGN_GUIDE §6, §6.5) →
project/web_prompts.json for tools/openai/images.py (Seedance API upload probe 2026-11-09: 429, long Retry-After → OpenAI per §5.3).

Characters = special versions of three for-women leads (face, hair colour, personality, voice unchanged; outfit / hairstyle / identity
changed — docs/proposals/2026-11-08_crossover.md F1-East: an UNNAMED fictional East, 蒼月国・白露宮; no real dynasty markers).
References COPIED into assets/art/ (never linked): ref_jin (Demo21 jin_gaze = lock_face) + ref_jin_close (jin_sheet), ref_shion (Demo22
shion_door) + ref_shion_close (ref_shion = lock_face), ref_saku (Demo30 saku_ref = lock_face) + ref_saku_close (crop of ref_saku).
Step 1: two design options each (design_<c>_a / _b → project/designs_contact.jpg) → pick → <c>_base.png. Picks = USER DECISION 2026-11-09 (overrides the team's first picks Shion B / Saku A, whose poses / blinks were discarded → assets/art/discarded/): Jin A (gold-dragon black robe, topknot + gold crown), Shion A WITHOUT glasses (user: 古代人不会戴眼镜 — shion_base = masked edit of design_shion_a removing the glasses and their chain), Saku B (black hooded cloak, low tie, fox mask at the belt). Anachronistic accessories (glasses, sunglasses, earbuds…) are dropped in historical / fantasy settings unless the story explains them (guide §11.1). Step 2: close poses reference
the pick; blinks = masked edits (face_points.json); mouths = LivePortrait sets (no talk variants).
Screens (character cards): Jin (dark, wine-red hair, black robe) light grey #c8c8c8; Shion (platinum hair, white robe) and Saku
chroma GREEN #00B140 ("matte": "green"). Style = for-women style card (style_3 soft cel, otome card finish, idol-handsome men).
Run: python3 scripts/prompts.py

design_jin_a.prompt:
Image 1 is the CHARACTER and STYLE reference: draw this exact young man (his face, eyes, hair colour). Image 2 is the same man closer (face reference).

Art style EXACTLY like image 1: soft modern anime illustration, thin coloured lineart, soft cel shading with one soft-edged shadow layer, romantic otome-game card quality, clean and calm, not glossy, no bloom, not realistic, not 3D. Realistic adult proportions (7.5 heads, not chibi). He is EXTREMELY handsome: an idol-level beautiful face, a clear jawline, long lashes, smooth fair skin, slim and tall with broad shoulders, no stubble.

Keep his FACE exactly as in images 1 and 2: the same eye shape, eye colour, eyebrows, nose, mouth, face shape and expression style — the same man, recognisable at once. Only his clothes and hairstyle change.

Jin: the exact young man from images 1-2 — vivid wine-red / crimson hair, sharp golden eyes, a cocky confident face with a dangerous half-smile, fair skin. Identity: the crown prince of the realm, feared as a tyrant — domineering, blunt, protective.

He now lives in an imaginary East-Asian-flavoured palace kingdom of long ago (an invented country, NOT any real dynasty or era): flowing layered silk robes with wrap collars, wide sleeves, embroidered sashes, jade and gold ornaments. NOT a Japanese kimono, NOT a samurai, no Tang or Ming court hats, no queue, nothing modern (no zips, no glasses frames of metal unless asked, no headphones).

Outfit A: a long black silk robe with GOLD DRAGON embroidery on the chest and sleeves, a wide black-and-gold sash with a white jade pendant, a crimson inner collar, wide sleeves. Hair A: his wine-red hair grown LONG, the upper half tied back in a small topknot held by a slim gold crown piece (the crown does not hide his red hair), the rest falling past his shoulders, messy red bangs.

He stands facing the viewer, from the thighs up, centre, at eye level, arms crossed, chin slightly raised, a cocky possessive half-smile, looking straight at the viewer. Mouth CLOSED.

Lighting on him: warm orange brazier light from the RIGHT of the picture, cool blue snowy window light from the LEFT.

Plain flat LIGHT GREY background (#c8c8c8), one even colour, completely empty: no scenery, no floor line, no shadow and no gradient on the background, no grey haze around him. His whole head and hair inside the frame with space above; his shoulders, arms and elbows not cut by the left or right picture edge (full figure inside the frame with margin at the sides). ONLY the character: no furniture, no brazier, no railing, no pillar, no other people, no other hands.

Wide 16:9 game art. No text, no letters, no captions, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.
